parts.text: This question is about organic chemistry.

parts.text: (a) Petroleum is a mixture of hydrocarbons and is separated by fractional distillation in an industrial process.

ms.text:

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Name the process that breaks down long chain hydrocarbon molecules to form short chain hydrocarbon molecules. ..................................................................................................................................... [1]
